notes.title: "Millennium Dream" Demo Takedown Announcement
notes.content: [p]To all players and friends who care about "Millennium Dream":[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45462186/eb05ea9b892cd56a0246f7494ab7707887a67b00.png"][/img][/p][p]First, I want to extend my heartfelt thanks for your continued attention and support for "Millennium Dream," and a special thank you to everyone who downloaded and played my early demo. Every exploration, piece of feedback, and word of encouragement has been an invaluable driving force for me on this development journey.[/p][p][/p][p]As development has progressed, the official version of "Millennium Dream" has grown significantly in terms of content, core gameplay, and environmental interactivity, creating a substantial difference from the current demo. To avoid having the old demo misrepresent the quality and gameplay of the final version, I feel it no longer accurately reflects the complete "Millennium Dream" experience I aim to deliver.[/p][p][/p][p]After careful consideration, I have decided to temporarily take down the existing "Millennium Dream" demo[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again for your understanding and patience. I am working at full capacity to bring you the complete, immersive world of "Millennium Dream" as soon as possible. Please continue to follow my official channels for the latest development updates.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 「Millennium Dream」"Demo Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hello Dreamers!

On this brief escape from reality, "Millennium Dream" will take you deep into your memories, exploring those old spaces shrouded in nostalgic warmth and eerie unease.

[h2]This demo version includes the following carefully crafted experience areas:[/h2]

The Way Home: A familiar yet lonely home, waiting for you to recover lost memories.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45462186/3a0468116ca7b2f1f051f8b75e50ca6129a5334e.png[/img]

Deserted Pedestrian Street: In the silent underground mall, only indifferent mannequins accompany your journey.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45462186/9d4ad88b90507b2b59b7ca1a21b6011d3846b0d8.png[/img]

Error Space-H: An abnormal space that defies common sense—what secrets are hidden beneath the pool?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45462186/ffcde2d803d998a85c4f303c747a776a87431f2b.png[/img]

Hidden Level: Every evening, the courtyard tree will guide you to the unknown…
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45462186/4cc13250d1149ac290ea964259e39d25af57a807.png[/img]

[h2]Based on previous tests, we have made significant optimizations:[/h2]

[list]
[*]
[/list] Fixed numerous crash bugs, greatly improving overall game stability.

[list]
[*]
[/list] Added dynamic weather and time systems.

[list]
[*]
[/list] Added a camera shake toggle to reduce 3D motion sickness.

[list]
[*]
[/list] Introduced more interactive content and explorable areas.

Thank you for your attention and support for "Millennium Dream"! The demo will be launched soon—stay tuned and get ready to step into that familiar yet strange dream world!

notes.title: [Indie Game In Development] "Millennium Dream" First Playtest Launch!
notes.content:
[h2]What’s the Main Goal of This Playtest? (Pay Attention!)[/h2]

Core Objective: Performance Stress Test!
We really need to see how the game runs on different PC setups. Whether you have a high-end rig or a budget machine, your feedback is super important for helping us optimize the game! (๑•̀ㅂ•́)و✧ Please tell us about your frame rates and whether the game runs smoothly for you!

[h2]Secondary Goal:
While you’re at it, let us know how our UI design and basic controls feel—are they stable and easy to use?[/h2]

❗❗❗ Very Important Notes (Please Read!) ❗❗❗

[b]Content is Extremely Early![/b]
This test version only contains a small number of unfinished test levels. The art and visuals are all at an early stage, and definitely do NOT represent the final quality of the game! Please understand that the main purpose here is to help us check the game’s performance foundation~

[b]Gameplay Not Implemented Yet![/b]
This build basically does NOT include the core gameplay (features like collecting, full photo simulation, or mini-games are not present yet), so it does NOT represent the final gameplay or content! Please don’t judge the game’s fun factor based on this version~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45462186/5ee2c395648d08545a67d9272cd2b8efe5913a17.png[/img]

[h2]What Kind of Game is “Millennium Dream”?[/h2]

Genre: Walking simulator focused on atmospheric exploration

Style: Realistic, VHS visual effects, nostalgic vibes

Planned core mechanics: Exploration and discovery, collecting old objects, photo simulation, mini-games with nostalgic flair

Story background: Set in China, around 1995-2005

[h2]📸 Special Event: Capture Your #MillenniumDreamMoment![/h2]

Even though the gameplay isn’t complete, we’ve included a basic photo mode! If you see any scenes that catch your eye while testing, feel free to snap a picture!

Share your creations: Post the photos or screenshots you take in “Millennium Dream” to Bilibili or any other platform you like—just remember to use the hashtag #千禧梦瞬间# (#MillenniumDreamMoment)!

We can’t wait to see your unique perspectives: Show us the atmospheric, story-rich corners you discover!

notes.title: 【Dev Log】From Millennial Apartments to Backrooms Depths—Scene Design Highlights!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This is a phase summary of our recent development progress, focusing on the updates in environment and scene design. From millennial-era residential neighborhoods to dimly lit apartment corridors, and now to the entry points of Backrooms Level 0 and the Poolcore, our team has been committed to recreating the unique atmosphere that belongs to a specific era and space. Here is a detailed overview of the recent main content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45462186/7adabc1189591b8a45a989fe7ef573f56552e025.png[/img]

At the initial stage, we focused on presenting the living atmosphere typical of old residential neighborhoods from the 2000s. Through meticulous modeling and texturing, we aimed to authentically restore those familiar architectural elements and furnishings. The scene then naturally transitions to the gloomy corridors of old apartment buildings. We've added realistic details such as vintage doorplates, peeling wall paint, and yellowed lighting, giving the entire environment a strong sense of life and period immersion, allowing players to deeply relate to the setting as they explore.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45462186/5ee2c395648d08545a67d9272cd2b8efe5913a17.png[/img]

Entering the Backrooms: Level 0 & Poolcore Entrance

In the latest development, the protagonist finally steps into the world of the "Backrooms." The first stop is the endless and disorienting Level 0—surrounded by repeating yellow wallpaper, twisting corridors, and a faint, persistent buzzing sound—all creating a unique sense of alienation and oppression. Here, we strive to capture the unsettling atmosphere of "liminal space," making every step forward full of the unknown.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45462186/1f219b935f2ffbb17a48efbcb890b26509d9d585.png[/img]

At the end of the video, as the protagonist gradually approaches a mysterious, damp hallway filled with water echoes, elements of the Poolcore quietly emerge, laying suspense for what’s to come. Through this seamless transition, we hope to leave players full of anticipation for the next stage of exploration.

notes.title: "Dev Log: The neighborhoods of that era are the secret gardens of our childhood
notes.content:
Lately, I’ve been working on nostalgic-style levels, and when I got to this “old neighborhood,” I suddenly felt like I’d traveled back to my childhood.

I can still vividly remember how, back then, as soon as evening rolled around, I’d rush to the activity area in the neighborhood without even putting down my schoolbag. Those rusty fitness contraptions that look so worn out now were our fiercely contested “play equipment” back in the day: the iron walking machine turned into a spaceship, the waist-twister became a racing steering wheel… And of course, there was that glossy, well-worn elephant slide—how many kids “flew” down its back in those days!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45462186/b052f21b55fb71c966b12ccbaf3438b27abbef77.png[/img]

Then there were those cobalt-blue glass windows on the residential buildings that always sparked my curiosity. Especially at night, when the lights came on behind them, the blue glass took on a mysterious yet warm glow, as if it hid another world inside. Every time I passed by, I couldn’t help sneaking a peek, wondering what the families behind those windows were eating for dinner or what TV show they were watching…
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45462186/e1022bf1897b90398ed842675582de1abfe5c75c.png[/img]

I can’t forget the rickety old iron gate on the first floor either, with its crooked mailbox plastered with faded ads and a frame covered in rust that seemed like it’d never get fixed. But those weathered, yellowing flyers held stories from that era: phone numbers for gas delivery, recruitment leaflets from tutoring centers, and long-forgotten brands lost to the river of time… Even now, seeing scenes like that still fills me with a special kind of warmth.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45462186/edf63b027c319b378576649395dc35d378fbcb28.png[/img]

While designing this level, I kept thinking that maybe each of us carries a neighborhood like this in our hearts—both familiar and strange. It’s a place that holds those childhood memories, joyful or bittersweet, gradually fading and yellowing with time, yet never truly forgotten.

So, what are your memories of an “old neighborhood” like?

notes.title: February's development update
notes.content:
[h2]February's development work has been progressing smoothly, and I'm excited to share the latest game updates with you[/h2]

This month, I mainly focused on optimizing character controls, enhancing visual effects, and enriching the gameplay experience. Here are the specific updates:  

[h3]🚀 1. Character Control Enhancements[/h3]
> Improved character movement fluidity and responsiveness, making controls feel more natural and smooth.  
> Refined camera shake details to make character actions more dynamic and immersive.  

[h3]🧗‍♂️ 2. New Ladder Climbing Mechanic[/h3]
> Characters can now climb ladders, adding new gameplay and exploration possibilities.  
> The ladder climbing controls are simple and intuitive, further enriching scene interactions.  

[h3]📼 3. VHS Effect Optimization[/h3]
> Adjusted the VHS visual filter for a more realistic look.  
> Optimized visual noise in the VHS effect to enhance player immersion and overall visual experience.  

[h3]🌃 4. Underground Pedestrian Street Level Update[/h3]
> Added an underground pedestrian street scene—do you remember the feeling of walking hand in hand with your parents back then?  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45462186/097d10756644297874269c803d1f9bcbf86adc0f.png[/img]

[h3]🏠 5. Millennium Wooden Interior Level Update[/h3]
> Introduced a nostalgic millennium-style wooden interior level, bringing you back to the warmth of your childhood home and letting you relive old memories.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45462186/d83c413e5d74d94e0ac1cfea8ddf4d5307a0fb8b.png[/img]

A huge thank you to all shareholders for your support and feedback! Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist! 🚀
